title: Scenario 3: Uttarakhand Forest Fire
description: High-intensity wildfire in dense pine canopy across steep Himalayan terrain in Chamoli.

steps.narration: [T+00s] CLEAR CANOPY OVERVIEW. Garhwal Himalayan forest reserves baseline stable.
[T+10s] 🔥 CANOPY INFERNO DETECTED! High-intensity thermal plume (FRP 36.8MW) in Chamoli pine forest.

active_fires.reason: Fast-moving crown fire in Chir Pine forest. Wind spread vector active.
active_fires.action: Mobilize SDRF / Forest fire crews. Establish aerial suppression.

steps.narration: [T+15s] ⚠️ HIGH WIND VECTOR DETECTED: 24 km/h NW wind driving fire front toward inhabited village valley.
[T+20s] 🚒 RAPID RESPONSE POST NOTIFIED: Chamoli Rapid Wildfire Response Post (7.4km, ETA 16m) alerted.
[T+25s] 📋 FOREST PROTOCOL: Class A wildfire. USE: Water tankers, fire lines, helicopter bambi bucket. AVOID driving in.
[T+30s] 🟢 EMERGENCY DISPATCH RECORDED. Aerial support requisition transmitted to Indian Air Force / NDRF.
